name: Simulate Hybrid
description: Simulate hybrid ambisonic impulse responses: image sources, optional edge diffraction around obstacles and at the edges of the room's boundary that open wider than 180 deg, and a directional feedback delay network tail. Needs the 'hybrid' extra and a closed room. Writes the responses to the impulse response graph under 'hybrid'.

inputParameters.name: run
inputParameters.description: Press to simulate. The hybrid takes seconds to minutes and Grasshopper recomputes on every upstream change, so it runs only when this is true; a button is added when it is not connected. Without it, the responses already on the scene's graph are passed on.

inputParameters.name: tail
inputParameters.description: Decay target of the tail: auto (reference if given, else ray_tracing), reference, ray_tracing (its own ray-traced reference), eyring or sabine (predicted, no simulation).

inputParameters.name: reference
inputParameters.description: Optional reference for the tail: connect the ir_graph output of Simulate Pyroomacoustics (recommended: the wire makes Grasshopper run the ray tracing first), or give a method name on the scene, e.g. 'pyroomacoustics'.

inputParameters.name: image_source_order
inputParameters.description: Highest image source order in the early field (default 3).

inputParameters.name: diffraction
inputParameters.description: Edge diffraction around obstacles and at the edges of the room's boundary that open wider than 180 deg: none (default), udfa, or btms (slow).

inputParameters.name: late_envelope
inputParameters.description: Shape the late field to the reference's late energy (default True; off for an Eyring or Sabine tail).

inputParameters.name: seed
inputParameters.description: Seed of the feedback matrices and delay jitter (default 42): the same scene gives the same responses.

inputParameters.name: normalize
inputParameters.description: Whether the impulse responses are peak-normalized (default True). The raw level is always kept.
